svg.title: Integrity audit versus metadata-only machine learning baseline
svg.desc: On this controlled byte-flip dataset, cryptographic audit detects every altered file; the metadata-only logistic baseline cannot distinguish paired files with identical metadata.
svg.text: What does each method actually detect?
Controlled, synthetic byte-flip trials · 24 files · 12 source clips
Paired clean/tampered examples have identical codec, dimensions, duration, file size and bitrate.
The ML baseline intentionally excludes the cryptographic result; it is not a deepfake detector.
